supplemental_print_pack.scope: 2026-09-16: 16 repaired ABS frame plates plus one four-board-pad TPU plate; camera carriage held. Originals preserved. Prepared for prototype slicing; native preview and physical qualification pending.
supplemental_print_pack.m5_socket_head_option: Geometry-conditional alternative: M5 DIN912/ISO4762 head 8.5mm OD x 5mm height plus one metal washer 5.3mm ID x 10mm OD, thickness <=1.2mm under each of 48 heads. Retain specified flanged nuts, total height <=6mm, and original bolt lengths. Verify full nylon engagement and >=2 full threads beyond nut. See M5_SOCKET_HEAD_CHECK.json. Not a strength or torque qualification.

authority.note: This is an all-printed alternative requested by the user. It has not passed load, creep, vibration, collision, optical, or received-camera fit qualification.

m6_x25_flange_head_clamp_bolt.release_gate: Seat the actual first bolt head fully and concentrically on the first printed 16.0 mm raised cap boss without force. Confirm the complete flange bears flat on the boss without bridging, rocking, gouging, or overhanging before using the remaining caps.

m6_din985_nyloc_nut.standard: DIN 985 or ISO 10511 low-pattern prevailing-torque nyloc
m6_din985_nyloc_nut.release_gate: Use the dedicated sacrificial received nut in 00G in the same hex orientation it will use when seated, confirm it traverses the channel and reaches the hex seat without force, then confirm the sacrificial retainer snaps fully home without touching the nut and the bolt develops prevailing torque. Discard that test nut after the gate; reserve four fresh nuts for the final board clamps.

independent_camera_safety_tether.load_path: all load-bearing cable, eyes, swages, and connector parts are metal; polymer cable coating is permitted
independent_camera_safety_tether.finished_length_measurement: load-bearing cable centerline from the cage-connector bearing point through the complete choker-eye circumference
independent_camera_safety_tether.evidence_required: manufacturer datasheet, permanent marking, or certificate traceable to the received finished assembly; seller-only unverified claims are insufficient

layout.low_structure_boundary: All connected low structure remains at y <= 0; only the two small clamp lips overlap the board top.

truss.section: single-piece open-top U lattice; two side truss planes joined by a full bottom wall
truss.splice: full-height keyed external open-top U collars; 104 mm collars serve upright/boom joints, 92 mm collars preserve crossbar root fastener access, and the 92 mm center crossbar collar uses two diagonally separated M5 axes per member end

board_clamp.saddle_revision: GROUNDED_v2: two permanent 10x30x16mm brace feet; clear 65x52mm receiver pocket above z68 ledges. Replaces old S1 geometry with floating brace starts. See cad/output/revisions/SADDLES_GROUNDED_v2. Mesh/layer-start checks passed; native slicing and physical qualification pending.
board_clamp.type: two mirrored no-drill front-corner compression saddles
board_clamp.load_path: The 120 x 120 mm tower feet bear on the bench. The caps register the frame and react overturning moment by pressing the board onto the same bench; they do not suspend portal weight from plywood.
board_clamp.required_bench_condition: Board underside and both tower feet must share one flat bench plane. Required unobstructed bench rectangle is B x=-120..730, y=-250..0 at z=-18; verify this measured clearance before printing.
board_clamp.clamp_drive_access: M6 x 25 external-hex flange-head bolts are driven only from above and bear on integrated 16.0 mm cap bosses raised 1.8 mm above the 8.0 mm cap body. M6 DIN 985 low-pattern nyloc nuts load horizontally into blind saddle pockets and each channel is mechanically closed by an individual printed snap retainer; no clamp hardware or tool access is required below the bench plane.
board_clamp.hard_stop_release_gate: 18.65 mm assumes the nominal 18.0 mm board plus a 0.8 mm captured TPU pad compressed by 0.15 mm. It is a prototype value only. Print the 00G saddle/nut-pocket coupon and confirm the received board thickness, boss and bolt-head seating, pad compression, M6 DIN 985 nyloc fit, retainer lock, full prevailing-torque engagement, and blind-bore tip clearance before production saddles.
board_clamp.tower_receiver: open-top double-cheek receiver with two rib-supported positive bearing ledges at B z=50; two diagonally separated M5 cross bolts per saddle align to reinforced upright stations at B (tower_x+1,z60) and (tower_x+13,z72), leaving flange/tool clearance while resisting rocking; tower dead load passes ledge-to-foot-to-bench; no unsupported roof

camera.model_reference: Arducam B0477 / vendor B0477.STEP proxy pending received-part comparison
camera.usb_notch: Legacy 26 mm side-wall notch retained in the already printed cage. Received-camera photos show USB on the back face opposite the lens, not the side. Use the supplemental USB-relief keeper; the old side-routing assumption is superseded. Full carriage cable clearance remains pending.
camera.keeper_usb_revision_status: Cover-only geometry checked; photo-informed 30 x 16 mm design plug allowance, not a measured specification. Physical insertion, locking-screw access, spacer contact after cover change, and full carriage route must be checked. User reports existing spacers secure the camera; retain them and the printed cage.
camera.retention: four-sided cradle plus a planar top keeper secured by four perimeter M4 bolts; the cage/keeper/camera is bench-assembled as one removable module, and every closure bolt remains driver-accessible through a discrete carriage service bore for installed torque checks
camera.leveling: three M4x70 screws inserted downward from above the carriage; each turns in an underside-loaded captured M4 nut beneath an intact cage-base roof, then locks with a washer and standard jam nut directly below the carriage; the keeper has aligned 10.5 mm tool/washer clearances
camera.xy_adjustment: three positive-lock camera X indices at B -12/0/+12 mm plus two positive-lock carriage Y positions at B +0/+21 mm. Install all three M4 leveling screws in the same labeled X index and all four M5 carriage bolts in the same Y row; round bores replace long friction slots so the camera cannot creep along an adjustment slot.
camera.secondary_retention: one complete factory-terminated, independently rated stainless 7x7 safety-tether assembly meeting procurement_constraints.independent_camera_safety_tether; >=130 mm laid-flat choker eye centered on the exposed right distal-boom station B (396.25,152.5) and captive screw-lock connector at the rear cage wing; installed centerline slack must be 20-105 mm across the selected positive-lock camera index
camera.shim_rule: Use the thinnest symmetric or single-side combination that removes rattle without forcing or distorting the received camera. On 2026-09-15 the user reported nominal 0.9 mm loose and 0.9+0.3 mm too tight; provide nominal 1.0 and 1.1 mm final options without another coupon print. Final selection and retention remain checked during cage assembly, not assumed passed.

mandatory_prototype_gates: Print camera_case_fit_gauge first and compare the received camera and lens without forcing either feature.

Install the square camera with its USB connector facing the rear USB opening, then verify the plug and bend radius pass behind the boom end, enter the right open-U channel, rise ahead of the root straps, and clear every boom, strap, keeper, and carriage surface.
Dry-assemble the empty portal and apply a static proof load greater than the camera/cage mass before installing the camera.
Verify that neither top clamp lip intersects T0, T1, or any direct tag artwork.
Verify the complete portal, fasteners, cable, and camera remain outside every robot route; generated proxy geometry is not collision proof.
Measure entrance-pupil height and lock the four carriage bolts and three leveling screws with witness marks.

Before installing all clamps, physically seat one received M6x25 flange head with measured head OD <=13.5 mm on the first integrated 16.0 mm raised cap boss and confirm full, concentric, flat, force-free seating with no flange overhang.

Before any overhead installation, verify the received complete factory-terminated tether and manufacturer evidence against every procurement constraint, then confirm both terminated connections close and lock without modifying the cable or fittings.
Do not power or move the robot until a superseding controlled build release authorizes this physical support.
